title: Sammy Squirrel's Hidden Acorn
description: Sammy hides his special acorn so well that he forgets where it is, learning the joy of sharing instead of hoarding.
character_reference: a bushy-tailed red squirrel with a bright orange vest and a patch on his left knee

scenes.narration: Sammy Squirrel found the biggest, shiniest acorn in the entire park and decided to hide it.
scenes.visual: red squirrel holding massive shiny brown acorn admiring it proudly in sunny park grass close up

scenes.narration: He dug a deep hole beneath a pine tree root, dropped his prize inside, and covered it with dirt.
scenes.visual: squirrel digging frantically with paws burying large acorn beneath pine tree roots side view sunny day

scenes.narration: He placed a small twig on top for a marker, but when he turned around, twenty other twigs looked identical.
scenes.visual: confused squirrel surrounded by dozens of identical pine twigs scratching head in frustration wide shot

scenes.narration: Sitting on a rock, he let out a sad little sigh because he could no longer find his treasure.
scenes.visual: squirrel sitting on mossy rock looking down with drooping ears and sad expression front view

scenes.narration: His neighbor Bella mouse hopped over and offered to share her stash of sweet berries with him instead.
scenes.visual: friendly mouse offering red berries to sad squirrel sitting on log warm friendly lighting

scenes.narration: Sammy smiled and realized that food tastes much better when shared than when locked away alone.
scenes.visual: squirrel and mouse eating berries together happily smiling outdoors in sunny garden clearing

scenes.narration: Months later, a tiny oak sapling sprouted right where he lost his acorn, creating shade for everyone.
scenes.visual: small green oak sapling growing out of soil in bright sunlight peaceful nature shot macro view

scenes.narration: Sammy learned that holding onto things too tightly keeps you from discovering the joy of sharing.
scenes.visual: squirrel resting happily against trunk of young tree looking at friendly forest animals passing by

scenes.narration: Be sure to follow along for more heartwarming bedtime stories every single day.
scenes.visual: peaceful forest under sunset sky warm orange and purple hues gentle whimsical bedtime mood
